meta.description:
Lake Chad, shared by Chad, Niger, Nigeria and Cameroon, has lost about 90% of its surface since the 1960s. Failed rains and heavy irrigation split it in two and turned open water into a maze of reeds and sand that around 30 million people depend on.

Watch our planet change in seconds. Accelerated geographic shifts, urban growth and climate overviews from a clean satellite perspective.

📍 Lake Chad, Central Africa · 1963 → 2024
🎬 Stylized satellite reconstruction based on real-world change.
